title: Seev HPA Saturation Evidence
description: Per-service load-test saturation metrics that back HPA target selection. Generated by scripts/load/collect-hpa-evidence.sh after a steady-state load run.

prometheus_window.description: Prometheus range window used for metric averages, e.g. '5m'

services.description: Keyed by service short name (gateway, auth, ledger, ...)

cpu_fraction.description: avg cpu usage / cpu request (0–1+). 'NaN' if metric unavailable.

memory_fraction.description: avg memory working set / memory request (0–1+). 'NaN' if unavailable.

request_rate_rps.description: HTTP request rate in requests/second during the window.

p95_latency_ms.description: p95 HTTP request latency in milliseconds during the window.

saturating_metric.description: The metric with the highest fraction — this is the signal HPA should track for this service.

recommended_hpa_target.description: Recommended CPU/metric utilization target (%) for HPA, set below saturation point to allow headroom. Populate after reviewing evidence.

notes.description: Free-text rationale for recommended target or any caveats.
